_comment: The inmates' voice lines (owner, 2026-10-20). Each clip is server/voicelines/<file>.mp3 (ElevenLabs eleven_v4, the flow in
CLAUDE.md's Voice lines bullet), said by <speaker> (the name the scripts pass to storySay/jjSay: Lefty, Rusty, Tank,
Whisper) and <text>: EXACTLY what the recording says. voice.sk plays it when that speaker says that text in person, so
when a script's line changes, its clip stops playing (make-voice-lines.js --check lists it as stale) instead of
saying the old words. match 'prefix': the line only starts with the text (the rest is filled in by the script).
Three texts below are the lines as recorded, before round 3 changed them (2026-10-20, after the recording): l_shop's
brief and done and l_card's done. Record the new text, then put it here.
Run tools\node\node.exe tools\make-voice-lines.js after a change (OGGs, sounds.json, voicelines.sk).

lines.speaker: Lefty
lines.text: New fish? Come sit with me in Hall B. Free advice.

lines.speaker: Lefty
lines.text: Nobody stays in here forever.

lines.speaker: Lefty
lines.text: Three ways past the fences: a keycard through the police station, C4 on the vehicle gate, or over the fence by the Gun Shop.

lines.speaker: Lefty
lines.text: Then the lot. The front gate opens from the gatehouse booth: a keycard gets you in, or punch its fuse box when the guards look away.

lines.speaker: Lefty
lines.text: First, get yourself sorted.

lines.speaker: Lefty
lines.text: The Gun Shop in the yard keeps your knives for when they lock you up again. Melee only in here.

lines.speaker: Lefty
lines.text: Smart. Now the fun part.

lines.speaker: Lefty
lines.text: The cafeteria counter: hold right-click on it and grab me a donut. Everything in here runs on donuts.

lines.speaker: Lefty
lines.text: Mm. You'll do.

lines.speaker: Lefty
lines.text: Putty in the workshop, wires in the supply closet, a timer in the infirmary: hold right-click to search each. Bring me all three and I put it together.

lines.speaker: Lefty
lines.text: Careful with that. The vehicle gate by the plaza: hold right-click on it to plant it, and you're in the lot.

lines.speaker: Lefty
lines.text: Knock a guard down, or ask Rusty in B1: he trades for donuts.

lines.speaker: Lefty
lines.text: The police station's yard door. Straight through, and the same card opens the gatehouse.

lines.speaker: Lefty
lines.text: That's everything I know. Get to the lot, open the front gate from the booth, and go.

lines.speaker: Lefty
lines.text: Knew you had it in you. Mara runs things out there: find her.

lines.speaker: Lefty
lines.text: Give me those. There: hold right-click on the vehicle gate by the plaza, then get clear.

lines.speaker: Lefty
lines.text: Four marks round the yard. Touch them in order; the clock starts at the first.

lines.speaker: Lefty
lines.text: One at a time. Use the one you've got.

lines.speaker: Lefty
lines.text: Free up a hand first.

lines.speaker: Lefty
lines.text: Mm, chocolate.

lines.speaker: Lefty
lines.text: You're not done down there yet.

lines.speaker: Lefty
lines.text: Got it. Whisper sends his regards, huh.

lines.speaker: Rusty
lines.text: Took you long enough. Name's Rusty.

lines.speaker: Rusty
lines.text: Here, a knife.
lines.where: jailcourse.sk jcRusty (the key is filled in)

lines.speaker: Rusty
lines.text: Your phone's in slot 9: press 9 and right-click to open the map. Out in the city it's your GPS; F opens the apps. The door opens from in here when you walk up to it.

lines.speaker: Rusty
lines.text: Good. The Security Office is down the hall, same keycard. Up the ladder and you're in the main block.

lines.speaker: Rusty
lines.text: Bring me a donut from the cafeteria counter. I make it worth your while.

lines.speaker: Rusty
lines.text: Ahh. Here.

lines.speaker: Rusty
lines.text: Do what I said.

lines.speaker: Rusty
lines.text: Got it. Whisper sends his regards, huh.

lines.speaker: Tank
lines.text: Get the guards on your tail, then shake them. I need them looking the other way.

lines.speaker: Tank
lines.text: You're not done down there yet.

lines.speaker: Tank
lines.text: Got it. Whisper sends his regards, huh.

lines.speaker: Whisper
lines.text: Somebody hid a stash in the yard. Bring it to me, and keep it away from the guards.

lines.speaker: Whisper
lines.text: Nice. Here's your cut.

lines.speaker: Whisper
lines.text: You're not done down there yet.
